description: An HTML webpage that provides a user interface to test clipboard copy functionalities, including modern API and fallback methods, along with environment info.

methods.name: testModernAPI
methods.description: Attempts to copy text to clipboard using the modern Clipboard API.

methods.name: testFallback
methods.description: Attempts to copy text to clipboard using the document.execCommand fallback method.

methods.name: testCombined
methods.description: Tries Clipboard API first, then falls back to execCommand if needed, to copy text.

methods.name: fallbackCopy
methods.description: Helper function to copy text using the execCommand fallback approach.

methods.name: testEmpty
methods.description: Validates whether the input string is empty, and displays appropriate message.
